tools.name: builder_catalog
tools.description: Discover Builder components, targets, settings, option IDs and defaults for deliberately creating a new project. Omit all filters for components; supply component for targets/settings; add edition and target for explicit option support. Target requires edition. Use catalogRevision in validate_project. Builder covers a configurable subset; absent settings do not establish unsupported product features.

component.description: Optional Builder component; omit for the component inventory

edition.description: Optional lite or pro; requires component

target.description: Optional advertised concrete target or alias; requires component and edition

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read the published DayPilot API/documentation/CODE article or JavaScript demo Markdown at a canonical source URL. Preserves examples and edition qualifications. Results include source, revision, content and continuation; pass nextOffset with the same revision to continue. References describe the current documentation, not every installed version.

url.description: Canonical published article URL on doc.daypilot.org, api.daypilot.org, code.daypilot.org, or javascript.daypilot.org/demo/

revision.description: Revision from the previous response to ensure consistent continuation

tools.name: generate_project
tools.description: Generate and verify a new Builder project ZIP using the same validated specification plus expectedProjectDigest. Returns a verified receipt and exact canonical POST download request, not ZIP bytes or a saved file. Download using that request, verify archive SHA-256 before extracting into a new directory, then follow generated README/AGENTS and check installation/build/runtime. Pro projects contain an evaluation trial. Never overwrite an existing app.

expectedProjectDigest.description: projectDigest returned by validate_project for the same specification

tools.name: render_theme
tools.description: Render complete CSS from a current theme_manifest revision, a unique CSS prefix and optional property overrides. Uses canonical defaults and validates settings. Returns CSS, SHA-256 and application guidance without saving a theme. Load CSS globally and use the prefix in the component's theme property; verify installed typings.

component.description: Component from theme_manifest: scheduler, calendar, month, gantt, kanban, or navigator

prefix.description: CSS prefix: 1–64 lower-case letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter or underscore

revision.description: Required revision returned by theme_manifest for this component

properties.description: Optional property overrides; booleans for checkbox, integers or canonical integer strings for number, strings for text/color/select. Omitted properties inherit source defaults

tools.name: resolve_package
tools.description: Resolve the latest official DayPilot Lite or Pro release for JavaScript, React, Angular or Vue. Returns package identity, license and installation guidance; Pro installation is a trial. Preserve an existing application's installed version and licensed dependency unless an upgrade is requested. Does not install packages or verify historical compatibility.

edition.description: Required edition: lite or pro; preserve the edition already used by an existing application

framework.description: Required framework: javascript, react, angular, or vue

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search official DayPilot documentation, API references, examples and release information. Accepts task descriptions or exact API identifiers. Returns ranked sources and exact-match groups with canonical URLs; use fetch to inspect supported results before making implementation claims.

query.description: Task or exact API identifier to search in official DayPilot sources

scope.description: Optional existing Search scope: api, documentation, demos, tutorials, release-notes, forum, or sites

tools.name: theme_manifest
tools.description: Discover supported theme settings, defaults and value domains for a DayPilot component. Returns a revision required by render_theme. Inspect the manifest before choosing overrides.

component.description: Component: scheduler, calendar, month, gantt, kanban, or navigator

tools.name: validate_project
tools.description: Preflight a new Builder project using a discovered catalogRevision, component, edition, target, projectName and setting-ID to option-ID map ({} uses defaults). Returns effective settings, qualified release identity, warnings and projectDigest for generate_project. Validates generation only; does not install, build or run the application. Preserve an existing application instead of regenerating it.

target.description: Advertised concrete target ID or alias

projectName.description: New project slug: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; maximum 60 characters

settings.description: Required canonical setting-ID to option-ID map; empty object uses catalog defaults
